messages:
maria (Marketing Lead): Ok team — finalizing run-of-show for the microstudio webinar. Need a crisp cue protocol so backstage can hand off demos without delays.
sam (Growth): +1. target audience: engineers + platform folks. want clear spots for cost/latency callouts.
alex (PM): Thinking: 45m total. 10m intros, 20m demos (2x10), 10m panel q&a, 5m CTA/closing. does that align?
devon (Producer): Works. For handoffs we need: 30s countdown, visual cue on greenroom, and pre-recorded fallback for each demo.
katie (Speaker Ops): Speakers confirmed: Priya (runtime), Omar (dedicated), Jess (customer). All can do mic checks Tues/Wed. Priya wants a 5m dry-run for the live demo.
maria (Marketing Lead): Priya should do the 5m live demo at the top of the demo block (first demo). Omar does the higher-throughput benchmark second. Jess covers customer story + short metrics.
sam (Growth): For the benchmark demo, call out: tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency, and cost per 1k tokens. Keep every metric in a single slide.
alex (PM): Agreed. Also add a slide showing fallback routing policy: hosted -> dedicated -> private (auto-fallback) + note on streaming continuity.
devon (Producer): Cue protocol draft: 
```
T-00:30 "prepare" visual on greenroom
T-00:10 "go live" overlay to presenter
T+00:00 presenter mic on, slide visible
T+02:30 demo traffic script start (producer triggers test inputs)
T+07:30 if live fails -> switch to pre-recorded clip (label: preprod-demo-priya.mp4)
```
katie (Speaker Ops): Can we standardize filenames for pre-recorded clips? e.g., webinar-YYYYMMDD-speakername-demo.mp4. Makes switching fast.
maria (Marketing Lead): Yes — adopt that pattern. devon, make sure we have the clips uploaded to the content bucket 24h before.
devon (Producer): Will do. Also tagging: add a short README in the bucket with fallback cues and sequence IDs. Infra-bot will post a presigned link once uploaded.
infra-bot: presigned link created: https://s3.redwood-inference.example/marketing/webinar/5412345678/preprod-demo-priya.mp4 (expires in 72h)
sam (Growth): For audience flow: invite asks one checkbox "I'm interested in hosted vs private" so we can route leads to the right sales path. Also add a follow-up survey question about latency/cost priorities.
alex (PM): Good. We'll attach a 1-page benchmark cheat sheet in follow-up email. Sam, can you draft copy for CTA: "See how we cut inference cost by X%" with two CTAs (trial + request demo)?
sam (Growth): On it. Draft by EOD today.
katie (Speaker Ops): Rehearsals: block 30m per speaker (10m mic + 20m run). Let's do slots Tue 10am-1pm. I'll post calendar invites.
maria (Marketing Lead): Final checklist before rehearsal: slides + demo inputs + pre-recorded clip uploaded + runbook link. If any item missing, move the speaker slot.
devon (Producer): I'll upload the runbook to the greenroom folder and ping infra-bot to verify assets.
infra-bot: asset check OK: slides(yes), clips(yes), presigned-links(yes). All assets present for 5412345678.
maria (Marketing Lead): Perfect. Last ask: produce a single-line cue card for each speaker: 1) 30s countdown 2) 10s 'wrap now' 3) handoff phrase: "Passing to next demo". Can someone draft the cards?
katie (Speaker Ops): I'll assemble and DM to each speaker.
sam (Growth): We'll A/B two subject lines in the invite: "Practical inference: cut per-token cost" vs "Serving LLMs: latency, cost, and reliability". will share variants.
alex (PM): One more ops note: start recording 2m before go-live to capture pre-show. devon set that in studio.
devon (Producer): On the scheduler. Also adding a visual "test signal" slide that only producers see when we want to validate streaming.
maria (Marketing Lead): Thanks — this is the last sync before rehearsals. If nothing blocks, we'll lock run-of-show tomorrow morning. :metal:
